outcome: Archived contacts disappear from listings without their history being destroyed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Archiving a contact removes it from the default listing.

expected_verification.assertion: a contact archived between two list() calls appears in the first and not the second

acceptance_criteria.text: An explicit includeArchived flag returns archived contacts, marked as archived.

expected_verification.assertion: list({ includeArchived: true }) returns the archived contact with archived_at set

acceptance_criteria.text: Archiving is reversible and destroys nothing.

expected_verification.assertion: restore() returns the contact to the default listing with its fields intact
